messages.dx.enchant.title: Essence Enchanting
messages.dx.socket.title: Rune Socketing
messages.dx.enchant.instructions: Enchanting randomly replaces the selected existing property. The old roll is lost. The first enchant permanently locks this property slot; only this slot can be re-enchanted afterward. Each attempt costs 1 matching essence and the listed gold.
messages.dx.enchant.firstLock: First enchant: permanently lock this slot. Other slots cannot be enchanted afterward.
messages.dx.enchant.locked: This item is locked: only this property slot can be re-enchanted.
messages.dx.socket.instructions: Each insertion consumes 1 rune permanently; runes cannot be removed. A normal item must have exactly the recipe's socket count and rune order to form a runeword.
